description: This PHP file defines classes and functions for database backup and dump operations, including creating SQL dumps, zipping files, and handling database connection details, specifically for vtiger CRM.

classes.name: DatabaseDump
classes.description: Handles creating SQL database dumps, including table structure and data, and saving to a file.

classes.name: createZip
classes.description: Creates ZIP archives from files and directories, with methods for adding files/directories and forcing download.

classes.name: createDirZip
classes.description: Extends createZip to add functionality for adding all files from a directory recursively.

methods.name: save_structure
methods.description: Saves the database structure and data into a dump file.

methods.name: DatabaseDump
methods.description: Constructor for DatabaseDump class, establishes database connection.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Creates a dump of the specified database and saves it to a file.

methods.name: file_open
methods.description: Opens a file handle for writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a string to the dump file.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Writes a string with a newline to the dump file.

methods.name: addDirectory
methods.description: Adds a directory entry to the ZIP archive.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file with data to the ZIP archive.

methods.name: getZippedfile
methods.description: Returns the complete ZIP archive as a string.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Forces download of the ZIP archive to the client.

methods.name: get_files_from_folder
methods.description: Recursively adds files from a folder into the ZIP archive.
